mechanism.claim: When BVOL and DVOL both expand during a completed hour, a large first-half BTC move followed by a larger same-direction second-half move identifies accelerating cross-venue price discovery; the direction should relay for six hours.
mechanism.side: common sign of the two completed half-hour BTC returns
mechanism.why_distinct: JVIAR requires same-direction intrahour acceleration under joint volatility expansion. OLIAH required opposite-direction absorption plus OI contraction; OIFAR used a full-hour shock and OI flush and traded reversal; CVVIB used fixed four-hour compression blocks.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: joint options-volatility ignition plus exact within-hour acceleration geometry is absent from Gross9

clock.decision: T after a completed UTC hour
clock.volatility_ignition: normalized completed-hour BVOL and DVOL bodies are both strictly positive
clock.price_source: 60 exact BTCUSDT 1m bars in [T-1h,T), split into minute offsets 0..29 and 30..59
clock.first_half_shock: nonzero absolute first-half return >= strictly-prior 720h q60 with 672 observations
clock.directional_acceleration: second-half return has the same nonzero sign and absolute magnitude >= first-half absolute magnitude
clock.trigger: false-to-true onset with prior source-valid consecutive hour
clock.reservation: global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR
